parameters.query: SELECT p.policy_id, p.max_value_per_tx_usd, p.hourly_velocity_limit_usd, p.daily_spending_limit_usd, p.human_approval_threshold_usd, (SELECT json_agg(LOWER(a.target_contract)) FROM agentic_guard.allowlists a WHERE a.policy_id = p.policy_id) AS allowed_contracts FROM agentic_guard.policies p WHERE p.policy_id = '{{ $json.policyId }}' AND p.is_active = TRUE FOR UPDATE;
